summary: Read two strings s1 and s2 that contain only lowercase letters. Both lengths lie between 1 and 10000. Decide whether s2 contains a stretch of consecutive indexes whose length equals the length of s1 and whose count of every letter matches s1. The order of letters inside that stretch may differ. Write true when such a stretch exists, and write false when it does not.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
